POSE 1: ISSUE - Unnatural floating, limbs lack support.
POSE 2: ISSUE - Floating mid-air without base, limbs disconnected.
POSE 3: OK - Seated balance stable, spine curved naturally.
POSE 4: OK - Symmetrical seated pose, arms balanced.
POSE 5: ISSUE - Legs intersecting seat, unnatural joint angles.
POSE 6: ISSUE - Extreme backbend, torso penetrating surface.
